sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 860. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 50000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 50000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70
